relations.subject: U Sīlānanda
relations.evidence: Venerable U Silananda became a novice at Mahvijjodaya Chaung Monastery, Sagaing Hills, under the preceptorship of Sayadaw U Paññāvanta... became a full-fledged monk at the same monastery with the same preceptor in 1947

relations.subject: U Sīlānanda
relations.evidence: While in Ceylon, he made a return to Burma and practiced Vipasana meditation with Mahāsi Sayadaw.

relations.subject: U Sīlānanda
relations.evidence: In 1960, after the death of his preceptor, he became the Abbot of Mahāvijjodaya Chaung Monastery.

relations.subject: U Sīlānanda
relations.object: Atithokdāyone Pali University in Shwegu Taik Monastery
relations.evidence: He taught and lectured at Atithokdāyone Pali University in Shwegu Taik Monastery, Mandalay and was appointed the Vice Abbot of that monastery in 1969. He taught Buddhist Scriptures, Pāli, Sanskrit, and Prakrit languages there.

relations.subject: U Sīlānanda
relations.object: Department of Oriental Studies, Art and Sciences University, Mandalay
relations.evidence: He was also an External Examiner of Bachelor's and Master's degrees for the Department of Oriental Studies, Art and Sciences University, Mandalay.

relations.subject: U Sīlānanda
relations.evidence: he was appointed as Chancellor of the newly-created International Theravda Buddhist Missionary University of Yangon in Myanmar.

relations.subject: U Sīlānanda
relations.evidence: Venerable U Silananda has been the Chief Meditation Teacher of Tathāgata Meditation Center in San Jose, California since it was founded in 1992.

relations.subject: U Sīlānanda
